notes.title: The current situation
notes.content:
Sadly steam has declined our application for a price reduction, as a result we are unable to change the price for 4 weeks. As a result we will attempt to apply a significant sale to the game when the current one expires.
I on behalf of Red Line Reality apologize for this entire situation.

On a side note we feel our trailer does not well represent the game or showcase enough gameplay, if anyone would like to submit gameplay footage for use in a new trailer we would be happy to consider it, just create a post here on the forums or at our facebook page @Red Line Reality. Thanks

notes.title: Pricing Changes
notes.content: Due to popular demand we are looking into lowering the price of this game, changes will take effect Monday. Unless you wish to support the development team please avoid buying the game today. Thanks

notes.title: Last patch before release! b v3.05
notes.content:
- Audio fixes for all ambient sounds
- Performance fixes for menu and level selection
- Countdown on deleting files (No more accidental save deletes!)
- All lighting baked to highest settings
- Updates to all text renders
- Some new decorational meshes added

* Movement system tweaked to emphasize directional momentum
